    {

/**

 *
 * @author Fabien Potencier <fabien@symfony.com>
 * @author Dariusz Rumiński <dariusz.ruminski@gmail.com>

final class LineEndingFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'All PHP files must use same line ending.',
            [
                new CodeSample(
                    "<?php \$b = \" \$a \r\n 123\"; \$a = <<<TEST\r\nAAAAA \r\n |\r\nTEST;\n"
                ),
            ]
        );
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyLineEndingNormalization($tokens);
    }

    public function applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag($tokens);
    }

    public function applyClosingTagOmission(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyClosingTagOmission($tokens);
    }

    public function applyShortOpenTagExpansion(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyShortOpenTagExpansion($tokens);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $configuration
     */
    public function applyEchoTagSyntaxRewrite(Tokens $tokens, array $configuration): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyEchoTagSyntaxRewrite($tokens, $configuration);
    }

    public function applyTrailingWhitespaceRemoval(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyTrailingWhitespaceRemoval($tokens);
    }

    public function applyBlankLineWhitespaceCleanup(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->createTagCoordinator()->applyBlankLineWhitespaceCleanup($tokens);
    }

    private function createTagCoordinator(): BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer
    {
        $coordinator = new BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer();
        $coordinator->setWhitespacesConfig($this->whitespacesConfig);

        return $coordinator;
    }
}

- `tests/Fixer/Phpdoc/PhpdocToCommentFixerTest.php`
